items.exampleEn: The package was sent with a carrier that delivers on weekends.
items.exampleZh: 這個包裹交給一家週末也送貨的貨運公司寄送。
items.glossZh: 貨運公司、運輸業者；攜帶者

items.exampleEn: Please send the invoice to our accounts office.
items.exampleZh: 請把請款單寄到我們的會計部門。

items.exampleEn: The shop's wares include cups, plates and bowls.
items.exampleZh: 這家店的商品包括杯子、盤子和碗。

items.exampleEn: The two companies haggled for weeks over the final price.
items.exampleZh: 兩家公司為了最終價格討價還價了好幾週。

items.exampleEn: The shop adds a mark-up of thirty percent to every item.
items.exampleZh: 這家店每件商品都加價三成。

items.exampleEn: Some news sites removed their paywall to attract more readers.
items.exampleZh: 有些新聞網站拿掉付費牆，以吸引更多讀者。

items.sentenceEn: The invoice arrived two weeks after the delivery.
items.sentenceZh: 請款單在送貨兩週之後才寄到。

items.audioEn: My mother loves to haggle with the fruit sellers at the market.
items.audioZh: 我媽媽很喜歡在市場跟水果攤販討價還價。
items.questionZh: 說話者的媽媽喜歡在市場做什麼？

items.sentenceEn: Which carrier will deliver our new desks?
items.sentenceZh: 哪一家貨運公司會運送我們的新桌子？

items.sentenceEn: The mark-up on bottled water at the airport is huge.
items.sentenceZh: 機場賣的瓶裝水加價幅度很大。

items.stemEn: Readers must pay to get past the website's ____.
items.stemZh: 讀者必須付費，才能越過這個網站的付費牆。

items.stemEn: Some buyers like to ____ over every price, even small ones.
items.stemZh: 有些買家喜歡每個價格都討價還價，連小錢也不放過。

items.passageEn: Anna sells candles that she makes at home. Last year, she sold her wares only at weekend markets, where customers loved to haggle. Now most of her orders come through her website. She uses a cheap carrier that collects the boxes from her door every Tuesday, and she sends each customer an invoice by email. Her mark-up is small, about twenty percent, because she wants to keep regular customers. She also writes popular articles about candle making on her site, but she has decided not to put them behind a paywall.
items.passageZh: Anna 賣自己在家做的蠟燭。去年，她只在週末市集擺攤賣貨，那裡的顧客很愛討價還價。現在她大部分的訂單都來自自己的網站。她找了一家便宜的貨運公司，每週二到她家門口收件，她也會用電子郵件寄請款單給每位顧客。她的加價幅度不高，大約兩成，因為她希望留住老顧客。她還在網站上寫製作蠟燭的熱門文章，但她決定不設付費牆。

questions.questionZh: Anna 怎麼把蠟燭送到顧客手上？
options: 自己開車送到每位顧客家
請便宜的貨運公司每週二來家門口收件
請顧客到週末市集取貨

items.promptZh: 那位老人在火車站外面擺攤賣他的商品。
referenceEn: The old man sells his wares outside the train station.
The old man sets up a stall outside the train station to sell his wares.
rubricZh: wares 是複數名詞，表示「（攤販的）商品、貨物」（例如 his wares、sells his wares 等）
「擺攤賣」可寫，例如 sells、sets up a stall to sell 等

items.promptZh: 她在二手車行跟業務員殺價，省了一大筆錢。
referenceEn: She haggled with the salesman at the used car shop and saved a lot of money.
At the second-hand car shop, she haggled with the salesperson and saved a large amount of money.
rubricZh: 「殺價」用 haggle，可接 with＋人、over／about＋價錢（例如 haggled with the salesman 等）
「二手車行」可寫，例如 used car shop、second-hand car shop 等
「省了一大筆錢」可寫，例如 saved a lot of money 等
時態配合內容（例如 haggled、has saved 等）；過去式、現在完成式都正確

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：首句「安娜在網路上賣自己在家做的蠟燭」多了原文沒有的「在網路上」（原文 "Anna sells candles that she makes at home."），且與下一句「去年只在週末市集」的時序對比先被說破（§11-20）。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 首句改「Anna 賣自己在家做的蠟燭。」，刪去「在網路上」；人名保留英文，題目同步

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：疑似：invoice 第一義「發票」在台灣常被理解成統一發票（收據），而商務 invoice 是賣方開出的「請款單、帳單」；例句寄到會計部門正是請款單用法。建議第一義改「請款單、帳單」，發票列後。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 釋義改「請款單、帳單；發票」，例句、聽打、閱讀中譯同步用「請款單」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：混合詞性題：干擾項中 embark（需接 on）與 invoice（及物，不接 over）都放不進 "____ over every price"，只有 hibernate 勉強合文法，未達「至少兩個干擾項文法放得進」（§11-26）。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: embark 換成 rotate（可接 over 的不及物動詞），hibernate、rotate 兩個干擾項都放得進空格，語意不通

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 B：haggle 卡與聽選都是「在市場殺價」
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 卡改 The two companies haggled for weeks over the final price.

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 B 疑似 11：wares 卡與翻譯都是街頭擺攤
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 卡改 The shop's wares include cups, plates and bowls.

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長裁示統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：wares 是複數名詞，表示「（攤販的）商品、貨物」（例如 his wares、sells his wares 等）／「擺攤賣」可寫，例如 sells、sets up a stall to sell 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長裁示統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：haggle 是不及物動詞，用法例如 haggle over the price、haggle with someone 等／句子要說到你自己的經驗

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 創辦人裁示：造句改翻譯：造句題（haggle）原位換成翻譯題，沿用題 id c1-u27-l01-q15；目標字沿用 haggle
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 translate：promptZh「她在二手車行跟業務員殺價，省了一大筆錢。」、hintWords ["haggle"]、referenceEn ["She haggled with the salesman at the used car shop and saved a lot of money.","At the second-hand car shop, she haggled with the salesperson and saved a large amount of money."]、rubricZh ["「殺價」用 haggle，可接 with＋人、over／about＋價錢（例如 haggled with the salesman 等）","「二手車行」可寫，例如 used car shop、second-hand car shop 等","「省了一大筆錢」可寫，例如 saved a lot of money 等","時態配合內容（例如 haggled、has saved 等）；過去式、現在完成式都正確"]（原 makeSentence：instructionZh「用 haggle 造一個句子，說說你殺價的經驗。」、referenceEn ["I haggled with the seller and got the bag for half the price.","I am not good at haggling, so I usually pay the full price."]）
